# PROVENANCE: third_party/voidlink

Verbatim reference copy of the VoidLink touch-widget subset, for the Madeira fork's VLTouch port (P2 of docs/fork/PLAN.md; design in docs/fork/TOUCH-PORT.md). Not compiled; not in the Xcode project.

- Source repo: https://github.com/The-Fried-Fish/VoidLink-previously-moonlight-zwm
- Branch: Integration
- Commit: fa42805997b7f82f1a9dc04d72e149cde4ebd07b
- Copied: 2026-10-30

## Licence note

VoidLink is GPL-3.0-only; Madeira is GPL-3.0-or-later, so the combined work is GPL-3.0. Most VoidLink file headers say "All rights reserved"; this copy is for personal use only — resolve before publishing (PLAN.md Facts).
